counting_rules.nodes: Semantic node identities, not repeated references, captions, groups, styling declarations or accessibility text.
counting_rules.edges: Directed semantic connections, excluding marker-definition triangles and node outlines.
counting_rules.group_membership: Each required node-to-enclosing-group pair; zero required memberships is not applicable, not evidence of grouping quality.
counting_rules.labels: Exact nonempty strings associated with the matching required directed edge; raw SVG associations inferred from spatial proximity and routing.
counting_rules.title: Exact title declaration/text present in source, not proof it appears visibly in renderer output.
counting_rules.presentation_objects: D2 disconnected shape:text title objects and the transparent architecture title wrapper are recorded separately; they are not domain nodes or domain groups. Structural object counts and semantic counts are distinguished.

limitations: Non-blinded agent review; judgment can miss source interpretation errors.
No parser validation, compilation success, visible semantic fidelity, typography, overlaps or title display can be concluded from these counts.
All repaired sources are judged to express required source semantics. This neither proves compilation nor visible semantic fidelity; consult separate renderer and visual results.
Raw SVG path/label associations are manually reconstructed, not declarative graph semantics; visible readability and occlusion need independent rendered-image review.
scope: All 15 repaired native sources and their initial counterparts; source-only review, no rendering or image inspection.
method: Read task requirements, initial audit and all initial/repaired sources. SHA-256 verifies unchanged inputs and audit linkage. Changed sources are manually reassessed, not semantically parsed or verified by code. Unchanged sources explicitly inherit the initial audit judgments. Code only serializes these manual judgments and computes hashes.
